title: release-provenance --pre mishandles X-rc.N launcher versions: checks platforms at rc strings, rcs eat the --limit window
description:
Found by the LCLI-625 reviewer (2026-09-28); recorded by the LCLI-625 implementer from the reviewer's report. Out of LCLI-625's scope, which kept --pre unchanged.

MECHANISM (scripts/release-provenance.mjs runPre, read at LCLI-625 branch head): --pre lists versions from the LAUNCHER's packument and checks every package of releasePackages() at each version string. Since LCLI-621 the launcher stages as X-rc.N, so that packument gains X-rc.N versions. parseVersion strips the prerelease suffix, so an rc is not filtered as unparseable or below the baseline. Consequences: (1) each rc is checked against all seven packages, and the six platform rows name versions like @opum-ai/lore-darwin-arm64@X-rc.N that will never exist; they report 'absent', which is loud but not red. (2) Each rc consumes a slot in the --limit window (default 10), pushing earlier releases' platform packages out of it. (3) The platforms at X are not re-checked until promote-latest.mjs puts X in the launcher's packument, and never for an abandoned rc that is never promoted.

REVIEWER'S SCRATCH MEASUREMENT (relayed, not re-run by the filer): against a stub packument [0.7.0, 0.7.1, 0.8.0-rc.1, 0.8.0-rc.2, 0.8.0-rc.3] with --limit 3, --pre checks only the three rcs against every package, never reaches 0.7.1, and exits 0.

TIMING: latent today, because no -rc launcher is on the registry yet. It must land before the first publish:true Release run under LCLI-621, since that run's rc is the first to enter the packument.

acceptanceCriteria.text: --pre never queries a platform package at an X-rc.N version: a test with a stub packument containing X-rc.N launcher versions asserts from the stub request log that no platform@X-rc.N attestation is requested
--pre re-verifies the platform packages at X for a release whose launcher packument holds only X-rc.N (staged, not yet promoted, or abandoned), proven by a test
The --limit window counts releases, not rc strings: with the reviewer packument [0.7.0, 0.7.1, 0.8.0-rc.1..3] and --limit 3, --pre reaches 0.7.1, and a test pins it
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0; a reviewer pass covers the scripts/ change
